verses.literal: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me saying

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖יךָ עַל־ הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֑יר וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām śîm pā·ne·ḵā ‘al- har śê·‘îr wə·hin·nā·ḇê ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Son of man set your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it

verses.original: וְאָמַ֣רְתָּ לּ֗וֹ כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ הִנְנִ֥י אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַר־ שֵׂעִ֑יר וְנָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עָלֶ֔יךָ וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ שְׁמָמָ֥ה וּמְשַׁמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā lōw kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nî ’ê·le·ḵā har- śê·‘îr wə·nā·ṭî·ṯî yā·ḏî ‘ā·le·ḵā ū·nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā šə·mā·māh ū·mə·šam·māh
verses.literal: and declare . . . that this is what the Lord GOD says Behold I am against you O Mount Seir I will stretch out My hand against you and make you a desolate waste

verses.original: עָרֶ֙יךָ֙ אָשִׂ֔ים חָרְבָּ֣ה וְאַתָּ֖ה תִֽהְיֶ֑ה שְׁמָמָ֣ה וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·re·ḵā ’ā·śîm ḥā·rə·bāh wə·’at·tāh ṯih·yeh šə·mā·māh wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will turn your cities into ruins and you will become a desolation Then you will know that I am the LORD

verses.original: יַ֗עַן הֱי֤וֹת לְךָ֙ עוֹלָ֔ם אֵיבַ֣ת וַתַּגֵּ֥ר אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל־ יְדֵי־ חָ֑רֶב בְּעֵ֣ת אֵידָ֔ם בְּעֵ֖ת קֵֽץ׃ עֲוֺ֥ן
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an hĕ·yō·wṯ lə·ḵā ‘ō·w·lām ’ê·ḇaṯ wat·tag·gêr ’eṯ- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- yə·ḏê- ḥā·reḇ bə·‘êṯ ’ê·ḏām bə·‘êṯ qêṣ ‘ă·wōn
verses.literal: Because you harbored an ancient hatred and delivered - the Israelites . . . over to . . . the sword in the time of their disaster at the final stage . . . of their punishment

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן אָ֗נִי חַי־ נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה כִּֽי־ אֶעֶשְׂךָ֖ לְדָ֥ם וְדָ֣ם יִרְדֲּפֶ֑ךָ אִם־ לֹ֥א שָׂנֵ֖אתָ דָ֛ם וְדָ֥ם יִרְדֲּפֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ā·nî ḥay- nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh kî- ’e·‘eś·ḵā lə·ḏām wə·ḏām yir·dă·p̄e·ḵā ’im- lō śā·nê·ṯā ḏām wə·ḏām yir·dă·p̄e·ḵā
verses.literal: therefore as surely as I live declares the Lord GOD I will give you over to bloodshed and [it] will pursue you Since you did not hate bloodshed it will pursue you

verses.original: וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת־ הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר לְשִֽׁמְמָ֖ה וּשְׁמָמָ֑ה וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נּוּ וָשָֽׁב׃ עֹבֵ֥ר
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- har śê·‘îr lə·šim·māh ū·šə·mā·māh wə·hiḵ·rat·tî mim·men·nū wā·šāḇ ‘ō·ḇêr
verses.literal: I will make - Mount Seir a desolate waste and will cut off from it those who come and go

verses.original: וּמִלֵּאתִ֥י אֶת־ הָרָ֖יו חֲלָלָ֑יו חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֖רֶב יִפְּל֥וּ בָהֶֽם׃ גִּבְעוֹתֶ֤יךָ וְגֵאוֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ וְכָל־ אֲפִיקֶ֔יךָ
verses.transliteration: ū·mil·lê·ṯî ’eṯ- hā·rāw ḥă·lā·lāw ḥal·lê- ḥe·reḇ yip·pə·lū ḇā·hem giḇ·‘ō·w·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḡê·’ō·w·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḵāl ’ă·p̄î·qe·ḵā
verses.literal: I will fill - its mountains with the slain those killed by the sword will fall on your hills in your valleys and in all your ravines

verses.original: אֶתֶּנְךָ֔ עוֹלָם֙ שִֽׁמְמ֤וֹת וְעָרֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תֵישַׁבְנָה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’et·ten·ḵā ‘ō·w·lām šim·mō·wṯ wə·‘ā·re·ḵā lō ṯē·šaḇ·nå̄h wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will make you a perpetual desolation and your cities will not be inhabited Then you will know that I am the LORD

verses.original: יַ֣עַן אֲ֠מָרְךָ אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֨י הַגּוֹיִ֜ם וְאֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֧י הָאֲרָצ֛וֹת תִהְיֶ֖ינָה לִ֥י וִֽירַשְׁנ֑וּהָ וַֽיהוָ֖ה הָיָֽה׃ שָׁ֥ם
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an ’ă·mā·rə·ḵā ’eṯ- šə·nê hag·gō·w·yim wə·’eṯ- šə·tê hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ṯih·ye·nāh lî wî·raš·nū·hā Yah·weh hā·yāh šām
verses.literal: Because you have said - These two nations - and countries will be ours and we will possess them even though the LORD was there

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן אָ֗נִי חַי־ נְאֻם֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ וְעָשִׂ֗יתִי כְּאַפְּךָ֙ וּכְקִנְאָ֣תְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתָה מִשִּׂנְאָתֶ֖יךָ בָּ֑ם וְנוֹדַ֥עְתִּי בָ֖ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶשְׁפְּטֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ā·nî ḥay- nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî kə·’ap·pə·ḵā ū·ḵə·qin·’ā·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯāh miś·śin·’ā·ṯe·ḵā bām wə·nō·w·ḏa‘·tî ḇām ka·’ă·šer ’eš·pə·ṭe·ḵā
verses.literal: therefore as surely as I live declares the Lord GOD I will treat you according to the anger and jealousy - you showed in your hatred against them and I will make Myself known among them when I judge you

verses.original: וְֽיָדַעְתָּ֮ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֒ שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי׀ אֶת־ כָּל־ נָאָֽצוֹתֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמַ֛רְתָּ עַל־ הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֣ר׀ שָׁמֵמָה נִתְּנ֖וּ לָ֥נוּ לְאָכְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh šā·ma‘·tî ’eṯ- kāl- nā·’ā·ṣō·w·ṯe·ḵā ’ă·šer ’ā·mar·tā ‘al- hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr šå̄·mē·må̄h nit·tə·nū lā·nū lə·’āḵ·lāh
verses.literal: Then you will know that I the LORD have heard - every contemptuous word - you uttered against the mountains of Israel when you said They are desolate they are given to us to devour

verses.original: וַתַּגְדִּ֤ילוּ עָלַי֙ בְּפִיכֶ֔ם וְהַעְתַּרְתֶּ֥ם דִּבְרֵיכֶ֑ם עָלַ֖י אֲנִ֖י שָׁמָֽעְתִּי׃ס
verses.literal: You boasted against Me with your mouth and multiplied your words against Me I heard it Myself

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אָמַ֖ר כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּשְׂמֹ֙חַ֙ אֶעֱשֶׂה־ לָּֽךְ׃ שְׁמָמָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ kiś·mō·aḥ ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lāḵ šə·mā·māh
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says While the whole earth rejoices I will make you desolate

verses.original: כְּשִׂמְחָ֨תְךָ֜ לְנַחְלַ֧ת בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁמֵ֖מָה כֵּ֣ן אֶעֱשֶׂה־ לָּ֑ךְ תִֽהְיֶ֤ה שְׁמָמָ֨ה הַר־ שֵׂעִיר֙ וְכָל־ אֱד֣וֹם כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kə·śim·ḥā·ṯə·ḵā lə·naḥ·laṯ bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘al ’ă·šer- šā·mê·māh kên ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lāḵ ṯih·yeh šə·mā·māh har- śê·‘îr wə·ḵāl ’ĕ·ḏō·wm kul·lāh wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: As you rejoiced when the inheritance of the house of Israel - - became desolate so will I do to you You will become a desolation O Mount Seir and so will all of Edom - Then they will know that I am the LORD
